ttl.name: Front Seat Assembly RH (Power Seat Type)

s-1.ptxt: Remove Power Seat Switch Knob (for Reclining)

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver with protective tape, remove the power seat switch knob (for reclining).

s-1.ptxt: Remove Power Seat Switch Knob (for Slide & Vertical)

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver with protective tape, remove the power seat switch knob (for slide & vertical).

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Seat Cushion Shield RH

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the rubber band at the rear of the separate type front seatback cover with pad.
Remove the 5 screws.
Disengage the 3 claws and remove the front seat cushion shield RH together with the front seat cushion shield inner NO.1 RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Seat Cushion Shield Inner NO.1 RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the screw, disengage the 3 claws and remove the front seat cushion shield inner NO.1 RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Seat Inner Belt Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector and each clamp.
Remove the nut and the front seat inner belt assembly RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Seat Cushion Shield Inner RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the screw and disengage the 3 claws.
Slide the front seat cushion shield inner RH in the direction of the arrow in the illustration, disengage the clip guide and remove it.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Power Seat Switch RH

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector.
Remove the 3 screws and the front power seat switch RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Separate Type Front Seat Cushion Cover w/ Pad

s2.ptxt: Using a clip remover, remove the 2 clips.
Disengage the 3 J-hooks.
Disengage each J-hook and remove the separate type front seat cushion cover with pad.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Separate Type Front Seat Cushion Cover RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 12 hog rings and the separate type front seat cushion cover RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Separate Type Front Seatback Cover w/ Pad

s2.ptxt: Remove the 3 hog rings.
Remove the 3 hog rings.
Remove the nut at the position shown in the illustration, and disconnect the bracket of the separate type front seatback cover RH.
Disengage the 4 claws and remove the 2 front seat headrest supports.
Remove the separate type front seatback cover with pad from the front seat frame & adjuster RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Separate Type Front Seatback Cover RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 8 hog rings and the separate type front seatback cover RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Reclining Adjuster Inside Cover RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 screws.
Disengage the clamp and guide, and remove the reclining adjuster inside cover RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Reclining Adjuster Inside Cover RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the screw and the reclining adjuster inside cover RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Reclining Adjuster Inside Cover LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 screws.
Disengage the clamp and guide, and remove the reclining adjuster inside cover LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Reclining Adjuster Inside Cover LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the screw and the reclining adjuster inside cover LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Seat Cushion Shield Lower RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the screw and the front seat cushion shield lower RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Seat Cushion Shield Lower LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the screw and the front seat cushion shield lower LH.
